items.doc_text:
FAQ (Frequently asked question)  
 
In Reference to the recruitment notice no. 739106 published on date: 05/11/2026 
 
Helpline for candidates: For any queries related to submission of Application and Recruitment  
Email:  csptclrecruitment@gmail.com 
Phone:  7353009191. (Between 09:00 AM to 06:00 PM on all working days)  
 
1. Eligibility : Eligibility of the candidates will be considered provisional, based on details 
furnished by the candidates in the ONLINE application. The CSPC will not undertake 
detailed scrutiny of applications for the eligibility, therefore, candidature will be accepted 
only provisionally subject to fulfilling basic eligibility criteria as required. Candidates 
must go through the requirements of educational q ualification, age, physical standards 
etc. and satisfy themselves that they are eligible for the post. The certificates/documents 
in support of their Educational Qualifications and Age/Caste/Category, etc. shall be 
sought at the time of Document Verification by CSPC. After scrutiny of the certificates/ 
documents of Educational Qualifications/age/caste/category. etc., if any claim made in 
the application is not substantiated by certificates/documents, the candidature of the 
candidate will be cancelled. Further, during any stage of the  recruitment or even 
thereafter, if it is found that any information about the candidate is false/incorrect or if 
the candidate has suppressed any relevant information or the candidate does not satisfy 
the eligibility criteria for the post, his/her candidature will be rejected forthwith. 
2. All the candidates seeking reservation/relaxation benefits applicable to SC/ST/            
OBC-NCL/Ex-Serviceman/PwD must ensure that they are entitled to such 
reservation/relaxation as per eligibility prescribed in the Rule s. They should be in 
possession of all the requisite certificates in the prescribed format in support of their 
claim as stipulated in the Rules. 
3. City allocation, Centre allocation and dates for CBTs will be allotted based on technical 
and logistical feasib ility. Candidates may have to travel to other cities for attending 
CBTs. Request for change of exam date/centre/date/shift shall not be allowed under any 
circumstances. 
4. Cloak room arrangement for safe-keeping of belongings may not be available at the exam 
venues. Therefore, candidates are  advised not to bring any valuables/banned items 
including mobile phones etc. to the examination venue. 
5. Candidates should enter their name, father name, mother name and date of birth as 
recorded in SSC/M atriculation/10th class exam certificate or an equivalent certific ate 
only, in Online application.  
 
6. Dates of CBTs and DV will be published on the official website  of CSPC. E-call letters 
for CBTs and DV (as applicable) should be downloaded  ONLY from the official 
webpages of CSPCs. The CBTs Centre, date and shift indicated in the e -call letter shall 
be final, and no request for change of date/time/place will be entertained. 
7. The mere issuance of an E -call letter does NOT imply that the candid ature of the 
candidate has been accepted for the subsequent stages of the recruitment process by the 
CSPC. At the time of examination, the appropriateness, authenticity & genuineness of 
their Photograph & Signature will be verified along with the other req uired credentials 
of the candidate before allowing them to take the exam. Credentials of the candidates 
will be verified along with authenticity of their submitted information at subsequent 
recruitment stages. 
8. CSPCs shall conduct verification of eligibility conditions (with reference to the original 
documents) only after the candidates have qualified in all the stages of examination and 
are provisionally shortlisted for Document Verification. At the time of Document 
Verification, the CSPC will verify the details provided in the online application against 
the original supporting documents submitted by the candidates. Any discrepancy 
between the information declared in the application and the supporting documents OR 
failure to meet the eligibility criteria (su ch as educational qualification, age, 
caste/category, standards , physical ground  etc.), will result in the rejection of the 
candidature. Furthermore, if at any stage of recruitment or afterward, it is discovered that 
the candidate has provided false inform ation or suppressed material facts, their 
candidature or appointment will be cancelled immediately, and if appointed, such 
candidates will be removed from service summarily. 
9. Training - All the finally recruited candidate shall be appointed as trainees for a 
minimum initial period of 06 months. During the said training period, the initial of basic 
pay as per the pay matrix  (Point no 04, the pay matrix page no 13 of the advertisement 
notice dated 05.11.2026) for the said post shall be payable monthly as a stipend. After  
successful completion  of the training period, the employee shall be  appointed on 
probation for a period of 03 year (which shall also include the training period) shall be  
paid the initial basi c pay as per the pay matrix for the said post, along with the other 
payable allowances—such as dearness allowance, house rent allowance etc. 
10. CSPCs reserve the right to change / modify / add / delete any of the terms & conditions 
of recruitment under the notification as necessitated and applicable at any stage. 
 
 
 
11. Candidates are advised, in their own interest, to submit their ONLINE application well 
before the closing date for submission of application and to avoid any last -minute rush. 
This precaution is recommended due to the possibility of heavy internet or website traffic 
during the final days. 
CSPCs shall not be responsible if candidates are not able to submit their ONLINE 
application within the last date for any reason whatsoever. 
12. PwD candidates (Person’s with disability) may apply against vacancies of a post even if 
no vacancies are exclusively reserved for them against that post, provided that the post 
is identified as reserved for the PwD (refer the order no. 550319/2026 dtd. 30.07.2026 of 
CSPTCL related to identification of posts for the category of disability for particular 
posts). 
13. For the post of Assistant Industrial Relation officer, the minimum essential qualification 
is Master’s/MA in S ociology with minimum 2 nd division or Master of Social Work 
(MSW) with minimum 2nd division only.  
 
 
   Chief Engineer(HR) 
   CSPTCL, Raipur
